mapper.select: SELECT MAX(substring(pg_get_expr(child.relpartbound, child.oid) FROM 'TO \(''([^'']+)''\)')) FROM pg_inherits inheritance JOIN pg_class parent ON parent.oid = inheritance.inhparent JOIN pg_class child ON child.oid = inheritance.inhrelid WHERE parent.relname = #{tableName} AND parent.relnamespace = to_regnamespace(current_schema()) AND pg_get_expr(child.relpartbound, child.oid) LIKE '% TO %'

SELECT substring(pg_get_expr(child.relpartbound, child.oid) FROM 'TO \(''([^'']+)''\)') AS partition_description FROM pg_inherits inheritance JOIN pg_class parent ON parent.oid = inheritance.inhparent JOIN pg_class child ON child.oid = inheritance.inhrelid WHERE parent.relname = #{tableName} AND parent.relnamespace = to_regnamespace(current_schema()) AND pg_get_expr(child.relpartbound, child.oid) LIKE '% TO %'
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName}_${newPartName} PARTITION OF ${tableName} FOR VALUES FROM (${previousPartDate}) TO (${newPartDate})
